answer.read: Family foundry (sup:70110) pushing a 9.5 % increase from a stale cost spreadsheet (doc:20260824-70110-M1, doc:20260909-70110-M4). It accepted our should-cost and notice-period points and moved from its opening to €134.00 at 14 d payment (offer:70110-1). It still leans on LCI-C and PPI-C241 movements and wants partnership and fast payment (doc:20260902-70110-M2, doc:20260917-70110-M3). Should-cost puts its full cost around €126-133, so it needs a modest increase to stay healthy. Its delivery record is weak: 85.2 % OTD, class B amber, an open 8D (sc:70110@2026Q3, qn:20004978). Status is open, not final.
answer.message: Thank you for revising your offer and for taking our cost and notice-period points on board. We value the long partnership and are keeping the fast payment you asked for. Given your recent delivery performance and the price level of our recent orders, we propose the attached terms, which we believe reflect a fair and sustainable increase for both sides.

The supplier's pace of concessions suggests it can reach this level in about one reply, and the status is still open, so accepting now would leave value on the table. Delivery and order-history arguments add pressure without repeating the kinds it has already heard.
